metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Husbands in Action
metas.description: An unpredictable operation by ex-husband Choong-sik and current husband Min-seok who unexpectedly join forces to rescue their wife who was kidnapped by a criminal organization.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2026 · Humint
metas.description: An espionage action film depicting North and South Korean secret agents clashing while investigating crimes occurring on the Vladivostok border.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · No Other Choice
metas.description: After being fired, a man devises a unique plan to secure a new job: eliminate his competition.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · The Assassin(s)
metas.description: In 1974, a shooting shocks South Korea. Detective Cheol-gu, who witnesses the attack, Jae-hwan, the city desk editor whose coverage is suppressed, and Young-il, a rookie reporter, begin to dig beneath the cover-up. As their pursuit of the truth deepens, they come to confront forces meant to remain unseen.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2025 · Good News
metas.description: In the 1970s, a covert team is determined to land a hijacked plane by any means necessary.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2025 · Revelations
metas.description: A pastor and a detective, driven by their beliefs, pursue a missing person case, with the pastor seeking retribution after a divine revelation identifies the culprit who abducted his son.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2025 · Yadang: The Snitch
metas.description: Navigating both the criminal underworld and law enforcement agencies, professional snitches called "yadang" provide covert information about the drug world to prosecutors and police. When a drug bust at a party attended by high-profile second-generation VIPs entangles those involved into a dangerous conspiracy, a seasoned yadang must do everything in his power not just to make it out on top, but alive.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2026 · Project Y
metas.description: Mi-sun and Do-kyung might be used to struggling in the most dangerous part of Seoul's Gangnam district, but that doesn't mean they've settled into it. With no one but each other to rely on, the two friends grind away to save the money needed to leave their dangerous lifestyles behind. But just as "retirement" comes within reach, the world betrays them, shattering their hopes. On the edge of a dead end, they discover a hidden fortune of dirty cash and gold in Gangnam – and place all their bets on one final high-stakes gamble of a lifetime.

metas.name: ★ 4.9 · 2025 · Streaming
metas.description: No.1 subscribed live streamer, Woo Sang, specializes in criminal profiling and covering crime-related mystery cases. One day, Woo Sang streams about an unsolved serial murder case and ends up unveiling the truth to some dark secrets through his channel.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2026 · Tristes Tropiques
metas.description: A group of young assassins, trained by the rainforest's absolute ruler known as 'Master' and affiliated with the organization 'Tristes Tropiques,' struggle with mutual distrust as they vow to exact bloody revenge.
